fact: On 30 May 2022 the director general of Congo's customs said the customs of Congo and DR Congo would interconnect their information systems before the end of 2022, and listed Sydonia World, e-douane and the clearance single window among reforms since 2016.
title: Lutte contre la criminalité transfrontalière : l'interconnexion sous peu des systèmes d'informations des douanes des deux Congo
